choices: A fraction with a denominator of 10, 100, 1000, etc.
A fraction with a numerator greater than the denominator
A fraction with a denominator of 1
A fraction with a numerator and denominator that are both zero
questions.solution: A decimal fraction is a fraction with a denominator of 10, 100, 1000, etc., because these denominators correspond to the base-10 system used in decimal notation. A fraction with a numerator greater than the denominator is an improper fraction, not specifically a decimal fraction. A fraction with a denominator of 1 is a whole number, not a decimal fraction. A fraction with both numerator and denominator as zero is undefined and not a valid fraction.

hi.solution: एक दशमलव भिन्न वह भिन्न होती है जिसका हर 10, 100, 1000 आदि होता है, क्योंकि इन हरों का अर्थ दशमलव प्रणाली में आधार-10 के संगत होता है। अंश वाला भिन्न जिसका हर अंश से बड़ा होता है, असंयुक्त भिन्न होता है, जो विशेष रूप से दशमलव भिन्न नहीं होता है। 1 के हर वाला भिन्न पूर्ण संख्या होती है, जो दशमलव भिन्न नहीं होती है। अंश और हर दोनों शून्य होते हैं वाला भिन्न अपरिभाषित होता है और वैध भिन्न नहीं होता है।

questions.stem: How are decimal fractions compared when the integer parts are equal?
choices: By comparing the digits in the first decimal place
By comparing the digits in the second decimal place
By comparing the digits in the third decimal place
By comparing the digits in the fourth decimal place
questions.solution: When the integer parts of decimal fractions are equal, the digits in the first decimal place are compared to determine which fraction is larger. This is because the first decimal place represents the highest value after the decimal point. Comparing later decimal places without first checking the first one would lead to incorrect conclusions.

questions.stem: A decimal fraction is written as 0.007. What is the place value of the digit 7?
choices: Tenths
Hundredths
Thousandths
Ten thousandths
questions.solution: In the decimal fraction 0.007, the digit 7 is in the thousandths place. The correct option states that the place value of the digit 7 is thousandths. The other options are incorrect because they describe the place values of the digits in different positions, not the position of the digit 7 in 0.007.
